text.tspan: From raw eddy-current samples to a confirmed crack and size estimate

svg.text: SPI register read → raw Rp_ohms, L_uH per tick

g.text: PCA on most recent N filtered (Rp, L) samples
→ dominant trend angle θ of the substrate.

svg.text: 4. Append rotated sample to rolling history
Least-squares fit y = a·x² + b·x + c
over the last crack_window rotated-L samples (x = index)
If sampleCount < 3 or fit is singular (a ≥ 0,
vertex outside window, fitted peak ≤ 0): return
silently. No reject_reason emitted — the detector
hasn't "started looking" for a crack yet.
checked in this priority order; first failure wins
phase = atan2(ΔL, ΔRp) of the window
— window too short to compute atan2
— still inside cooldown of prior detection
emitted as its own Teleplot line per rejected tick
smoothing, crack_window, crack_threshold, crack_r2, crack_phase_min/max, crack_scale, delay are runtime-tunable via the serial CLI.
Run `status` to see current values; run `help` to see matching command names.
